decisions.reason: A two-component glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm's core spraying and multi-component coating know-how, so it can read early market feedback and refine the system with its in-house engineering.

The low-pressure injection pump extends the firm's established injection and construction-repair pump expertise and has its own page, so the firm is well placed to assimilate customer learning and improve it.
A multi-model low-pressure transfer pump line sits squarely in the firm's material conveying competence, and early results across models feed into existing pump development.

Fire protection flow monitoring draws less on the firm's core application know-how, but it supports the firm's digitalization and monitoring direction and has its own page, so management keeps it for now while it builds sensor and monitoring knowledge.
